title: Bob Beckwith, Philadelphia Experiment and teleportation

tellings.quote: Yes. Does he say cuz he claims that I think he was maybe somewhat involved in the Philadelphia experiment and then he later did some really interesting work with like extremely high magnetic fields and and then and teleportation.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that a man named Robert Beckwith claims he was somewhat involved in the Philadelphia Experiment, a rumored US Navy test from the 1940s. Michels adds that Beckwith later did interesting work with extremely strong magnetic fields and with teleportation, meaning moving things instantly from one place to another. If true, it would tie those rumored wartime experiments to real, ongoing research.
